frame.axes: +x is east and +y is south when rotationDeg is 0; z is up
frame.origin: the minimum corner of the outline
frame.cells: cell [x, y] is the 1 m square from x to x+1 and y to y+1; floorCells rows are [y, x0, x1] covering x0 to x1-1
frame.levels: every level from 0 to storeys has floor on floorCells: level 0 is the ground floor and level storeys is the roof deck
frame.walls: walls are centrelines on the outline; the kit wall, kit.wallThicknessM thick, is centred on its line
frame.rotation: world = at + R(rotationDeg) * (p - pivot), where R turns +x toward +y, which is clockwise on a north-up map
frame.angles: roof.ridgeAxisDeg is the ridge direction in this frame, degrees from +x toward +y, at least 0 and under 180; roof.ridgeBearingMeasuredDeg is its compass bearing on the real house
frame.geographic: latitude and longitude are WGS 84 degrees of placements.true.at, the centre of the outline bounds on the real house
frame.fit: placements.grid.fitIoU and placements.true.fitIoU are the intersection over union of the outline, placed with that pose, and the measured footprint
frame.edges: placements.grid.suppressedWallEdges are [polygon, ring, edge] indices into outline, where edge i runs from ring[i] to ring[i+1]

kit.interiors: not-surveyed; closed exterior proxy; no invented doors, stairs or room partitions

roof.heights: eaveM, upperEaveM and ridgeM are metres above groundM; groundM is NAVD88 metres; ridgeAxisDeg is in the part frame; coverage is the share, 0 to 1, of the outline that lidar roof returns cover

provenance.footprint: grid-generalized county sketch placed on its 2018 lidar roof (reference/county-buildings.json); original geographicGeometry retained
provenance.details: Repeated windows, roof form and facade divisions are approximations; no surveyed doors or interiors.

grid.frame: Mount Dora town metres, east and south

true.frame: Mount Dora town metres, east and south
true.basis: the inverse of the grid fit

derivation.note: Coherent cardinal lines and one-metre integer tile edges; geographic source retained.
